_: Written by `ci-video narrate`. Records which line each mp3 is a read of, in which voice, on which engine, at what prosody — so a later edit to any of those can be detected instead of silently keeping the old recording. Commit this with the mp3s.

ask-a-question.text: Ask from your offline field library. A model you run writes the answer.

check-the-sources.text: Open the source passages and verify the answer before you act.

first-launch.text: On first launch the library is empty, and the panel says so plainly.

field-library.text: Copy reference documents into the sources volume. Ingestion indexes them.

no-model-no-panic.text: If no language model is installed, the app says so and the library stays browseable.

recap.text: Your documents, your questions, your answers. It keeps working when the network does not.

close.text: Build your offline field library with Just In Case, at ci dot computer slash J I C. UnCloud your life.

the-manuals.text: FEMA, the US Army and Wikipedia publish all of this for free. Reading it still takes a network.

open.text: There is no signal. How long do you boil creek water?

what-you-can-ask.text: First aid, power, water, food. The suggestions come from the shelf itself.

type-a-question.text: Type any question in plain language; nothing leaves the device to answer it.

library-shelf.text: The whole shelf stays browsable offline, on hardware you own.

no-network.text: The network is gone and nothing changes. The encyclopedia is on the box too.
